auditor_sam: Need ISO/SOC2 evidence for the June 30 emergency KMS rotate triggered by an exposed CI deploy token. Please provide RBAC change log, KMS rotate CloudTrail line, runbook trace, and signed manifest proofs.

nina: Summary: token leak in pipeline C -> temporary RBAC lockout on svc-deploy (06:18-06:42 UTC). KMS alias rotated: alias/redwood-emergency at 06:25:14 UTC. Runbook run id rb-20240630-21, approved by kevin.

kevin: I approved at 06:20:05 UTC (ticket SEC-2024-131). Comment: "approve emergency rotate, contain token exposure."

nina: CloudTrail extract we included: `2024-06-30T06:25:14Z | arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ops-runner/session | RotateKey | arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/hh11-22aa-33bb`

nina: RBAC change record: `id=rbac-8421 actor=nina target=svc-deploy change=remove:role/maintainer start=2024-06-30T06:18:02Z revert=2024-06-30T06:42:00Z ticket=SEC-2024-131`

kevin: Runbook stdout snippet: [06:20:10] rb-20240630-21 awaiting approval -> [06:20:05] kevin: approve -> [06:25:14] RotateKey succeeded -> [06:27:00] token-store rewrap: processed=57 errors=0

nina: Chain-of-custody: manifest (manifest.json) with SHA256 and CI-SIGN-KEY signature, stored in s3://audit-evidence/20240630/ with object-lock governance=90d. EvidenceLedger export attached (ledger-id: e-ledger-2024).

auditor_sam: Need CSV sha for Splunk scope and assurance that blobstore wasn't rewrapped.

nina: Splunk CSV sha256: `b1d2c3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c`

kevin: Blobstore uses alias/redwood-blob (key id k-blob-99), no ReEncrypt events in timeframe. We'll attach CloudTrail filter result.

sec-bot: integrity-scan passed for s3://audit-evidence/20240630/incident-131/ - checksums ok, signatures present.

auditor_sam: Good. Please upload a single zipped bundle and post presigned URL (7d) + signed manifest. ETA?

nina: ETA 2024-06-30 18:00 PDT. Will tag here when uploaded.
